entrypoints.description: AssertionNormalizer owns typed scalar/unit/dimension normalization before reconciliation.
Grounded Reality projection maps explicit Evidence roles into immutable FactAssertions without inventing occurrence semantics.
Typed read boundary reconstructs explicit multi-source Reality disagreement from conflict members without exposing storage tables to product code.

extension_seams: Add predicate-specific normalization/comparability rules through existing typed profiles.
Add generic Reality projection fields only when real cross-industry evidence cannot be represented truthfully.
Expose explicit reconciliation conflicts through typed read models while deriving historical visibility only from member source-known time and reusing Reconciler source-cluster independence.

guards.contains: ADD COLUMN valid_time_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown'
guards.description: Canonical Reality stores valid-time kind explicitly rather than inferring from null bounds.

guards.contains: state is true as of T; onset unknown
guards.description: Observation/as-of time is preserved separately from unknown occurrence onset.
Temporal precision tests protect source-supported fact time semantics.

PostgreSQL smoke requires two independent source clusters, Evidence references and source-known cutoff visibility before presenting a Reality source disagreement; different connectors in one source cluster are rejected as independent corroboration.

non_goals: Inferring exact occurrence dates from coarse or unknown source time.
Treating an observation/as-of timestamp as the start of a state when onset is unknown.
Treating conflict-case opened_at or other research curation time as historical market-known time.
Treating multiple connectors from one source_cluster as independent sources.
purpose: Own typed Fact normalization, comparability, canonical Reality and explicit reconciliation-conflict semantics. This includes source-supported valid-time precision, observation/as-of state with unknown onset, and a typed read boundary for multi-source disagreement whose historical visibility is derived from member assertion known-time rather than later research curation timestamps and whose source independence reuses Fact/Reconciler source_cluster semantics.
revisit_when: Only replace if an equally explicit generic model preserves typed value, comparability, evidence provenance, reconciliation, source-cluster independence, source precision, observation/unknown-onset semantics, valid/known-time boundaries and multi-source conflict lineage.
title: Canonical Reality normalization and reconciliation
